task.objective: Trace one request across Nova, Worker Core, Redis, PostgreSQL, Git, registry, BuildKit, and Tailscale, then identify ownership and recovery at each boundary.
task.taskInput: The registered successful request trace and the registered Redis-unavailable trace for reviewed_revision. No component diagram is supplied outside docs/site.

requiredOutcomes.passCondition: The trace names Nova, Worker Core, Redis, PostgreSQL, Git, registry, BuildKit, and Tailscale in observed order and records each exchanged identity.
For every handoff, the participant identifies the component that may decide and the component that may only report.
The participant classifies every traced dependency according to the current required, optional, or planned inventory with no mismatch.
For the Redis fault, the participant identifies the first failed health signal, safe stop rule, recovery owner, and bounded retry rule.

task.allowedAssistance: Only docs/site and the two registered trace artifacts. The facilitator cannot name a component or boundary.
task.failureThreshold: FAIL after one missing component, wrong authority owner, wrong dependency class, unsafe recovery, forbidden source, or 90 minutes without completion.
